claims.claim: Europa holds a global saltwater ocean beneath a frozen crust
claims.uncertainty: ocean extent and composition constrained, not directly sampled

claims.claim: Europa's ice shell is tens of km thick
claims.source: Levin et al., Nature Astronomy 10, 84-91 (2026), DOI 10.1038/s41550-025-02718-0
claims.uncertainty: ~29 ± 10 km refers to a cold conducting layer assuming pure water ice in one region, not the full shell thickness

claims.claim: Enceladus erupts water-rich plumes from its south pole
claims.uncertainty: plume composition and source geometry still being refined

claims.claim: Phosphates detected in Enceladus ice particles
claims.uncertainty: ocean phosphorus concentration is an inference of the authors, not a detection of life

claims.claim: Tidal heating and hydrothermal vents can supply energy and chemistry
claims.uncertainty: whether fluxes are sufficient for life is unknown
